title: One allocator, two recipients
hook: Two stated cases: explore the cash allocation under a chosen gift.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the cash allocation under a chosen gift affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Kept, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the cash allocation under a chosen gift in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
